_note: Starting scales per design system, taken from each system's public guidelines. They are a starting point: the designer can change any value in design-system.config.js. minTap = finger screens (phone), minTapDesktop = mouse screens (admin / desktop pages).

apple.label: Apple Human Interface Guidelines (iOS)
apple.style: Apple HIG (iOS 27), Liquid Glass: calm, content first, translucent bars, little decoration
must: Tap areas are at least 44 × 44 pt (the visible control may be smaller if its tap area is not)
Content comes first: bars are translucent and step back
Large titles on top-level screens; a back button on every pushed screen
Works in light and dark mode
Bars and tab bar stay clear of the notch and home indicator (safe areas)
cannot: No spacing, rounding or text size off the scales
No pure black (#000) text; use the Text colour
No new colours outside the theme tokens
No more than one filled (primary) button per screen
No custom controls where a system one exists (switch, segmented control, sheet)

material.label: Google Material 3
material.style: Material 3 Expressive: bold shapes, tonal surfaces, clear hierarchy, motion with purpose
must: Touch targets are at least 48 × 48 dp
Colours come from the colour roles (primary, secondary, surface, on-surface...)
Type comes from the type scale roles (display, headline, title, body, label)
Works in light and dark themes
Shapes follow the shape scale
cannot: No spacing, rounding or text size off the scales
No colours outside the colour roles
No more than one FAB per screen
No pure black text on light surfaces; use on-surface
No icons outside the chosen icon set

fluent.label: Microsoft Fluent 2
fluent.style: Fluent 2: calm, familiar, efficient; soft depth, clear focus states
must: Every control has a visible focus state
Colours come from the brand and neutral tokens
Text uses the type ramp
Works in light, dark and high contrast
Pointer targets at least 24 px, touch targets at least 44 px
cannot: No spacing, rounding or text size off the scales
No colours outside the tokens
No pure black text; use the neutral foreground
No more than one primary button per area
No icons outside the chosen icon set

carbon.label: IBM Carbon
carbon.style: Carbon v11: productive, precise, square; strong grid and clear data
must: Layout follows the 2x grid and spacing scale
Colours come from the theme tokens (White, G10, G90, G100)
Type uses the productive or expressive type sets
Every interactive element has a focus outline
Data tables and forms use the standard row heights
cannot: No spacing, rounding or text size off the scales
No rounded cards or buttons (Carbon is square)
No colours outside the theme tokens
No more than one primary button per group
No icons outside the Carbon icon set or the chosen set

ant.label: Ant Design
ant.style: Ant Design v6: natural, certain, meaningful, growing; dense and efficient for back-office work
must: Spacing follows the 8 px base (4 px for small steps)
Colours come from the seed and map tokens
Text uses the font size tokens
Destructive actions ask for confirmation
Every form field has a label
cannot: No spacing, rounding or text size off the scales
No colours outside the tokens
No pure black text; use colorText
No more than one primary button per area
No icons outside the chosen icon set
